# Direct-series fixture provenance

Reviewed September 11, 2026. These are small factual schedule/structured-event excerpts, not complete publisher pages.

- `shakes.html`: headings and individual performance rows from https://sfshakes.org/performance/free-shakes/ac/ plus the published 2026 title and approximate 90-minute duration. Includes out-of-SF sections to verify exclusion; historical Orinda rows must not be interpreted as 2026 SF performances.
- `market.html`: Event JSON-LD from https://www.fromtheesf.com/events/from-the-e-latino-heritage-month-night-market. Explicit Pacific offsets, scheduled status, free-community admission wording, and Ocean/Mission venue. Coordinates are absent and supplied only through the reviewed city intersection join.
